finding: Slovak bank loan availability expectations diverged from EA trend in wave 39
bullets: A net 6.5% of Slovak firms (n=104) expected bank loan availability to deteriorate, worsening 1.3 pp from wave 38, while EA expectations improved 1.5 pp to a net 2.4% expecting deterioration — suggesting tighter domestic credit conditions ahead.

Slovak firms' trade credit availability expectations improved, with the net share expecting deterioration falling from 10.2% to 6.2% (n=90), compared with the EA's net 1.9% — easing pressure on liquidity chains.
Credit line availability expectations for Slovak firms (n=136) eased 3.2 pp to a net 3.9% expecting deterioration, approaching the EA's net 2.3% — reducing near-term financing risks.
chart_subtitle: Net 6.5% of Slovak firms expect bank loan deterioration.
